references.text: Verse 22 completes the action of verse 16 by showing Abraham's transition from host to intercessor as the men continue toward Sodom.
Verse 4 shows Abraham's return to the holy place he left in verse 16, emphasizing the continuity of his intercession.
Verse 6 concludes the episode begun in verse 16 and shows Abraham returning to his place after the Lord has departed from him.
The Epistle to the Hebrews reflects on Abraham's journey, of which verse 16 is a concrete example.
Verse 14 describes God's departure, which immediately leads to the men's journey in verse 16.
